reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Moist Sun Serum 50mL
reviews.text: I absolutely love this sunscreen because it feels more like skincare than sunscreen. I love that it is light, clear and there's no sunscreen smell. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and gives me a glow. I would highly recommend.
reviews.zh: 我超鍾意呢支防曬，因為佢用落去感覺更似護膚品多過防曬。我鍾意佢夠輕、夠透，而且冇一般防曬嗰種味道。搽完皮膚覺得保濕，仲有水光感。非常推薦。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Moist Sun Serum 50mL
reviews.text: I love this sunscreen! It's very lightweight and applies easily. Perfect for days when I'm not doing any heavy activity (which is most days for me 😂). I definitely don't recommend this if you know you will be sweating out in the sun a lot, but for an average day sunscreen, it's perfect!
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢支防曬！佢好輕身，而且好容易搽得開。如果今日冇乜劇烈活動嘅日子就最啱（對我嚟講大部分日子都係咁 😂）。如果你知道自己會喺太陽下猛出汗，我就一定唔推薦呢支；不過作為一般日常用嘅防曬，佢真係啱啱好！

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Moist Sun Serum 50mL
reviews.text: This is an okay sunscreen, not bad but I've used better. I don't experience any burning of my eyes like others do but it is pretty greasy. When I tested it on the back of my hand, I could tell how greasy it is but I don't feel it on my face, it's just apparent from the sheen left on your face after applying. Some powder does take down the sheen so it's an easy fix but it could be a better sunscreen so I don't have to do that.
reviews.zh: 呢支防曬一般啦，唔算差，但我用過更好嘅。我自己就冇好似其他人咁覺得眼仔刺痛，不過佢真係幾油笠。我喺手背試過，已經感受到佢幾油笠，但搽上面就唔太覺，反而係搽完之後面上有明顯嘅油光。少少碎粉就可以壓返個油光，所以都好易解決，不過支防曬如果做好啲，我就唔使咁煩。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Moist Sun Serum 50mL
reviews.text:
✅ Doesn’t clog pores
✅ No white cast
✅ Absorbs into the skin like a dream
❌ But it does sting the eyes a little—ouch! 😅

Overall, it’s giving lightweight and skin-friendly vibes. Just gotta be careful around the eye area! I’ll keep testing and see how it holds up with continued use. Skincare journey continues! ✨🧴
reviews.zh:
✅ 唔會堵塞毛孔
✅ 冇泛白
✅ 吸收得好似發夢咁
❌ 不過眼仔會有少少刺痛——好痛啊！😅

整體嚟講，佢輕身又親膚。不過眼周位置要小心啲！我會繼續試吓，睇吓持續用落去效果如何。護膚之路繼續！✨🧴

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Moist Sun Serum 50mL
reviews.text:
Not for sensitive skin. I use a high % of tretinoin at night, so I often have dry patches and sensitized skin. 
I got this because I wanted something more moisturizing than my usual round lab birch juice spf. In comparison, this is a little heavier/better for dry skin. But it really irritates my skin, my face will be red and burning for the five minutes after I’ve applied it.
reviews.zh:
敏感肌唔啱用。我夜晚用高濃度 tretinoin，所以成日都有乾燥甩皮同皮膚敏感嘅情況。
我買呢支係因為想搵一支保濕過我平時用嘅 round lab 樺樹汁防曬。比較之下，呢支質地稍為厚啲，亦都啱返乾性肌。但佢真係好刺激我嘅皮膚，搽完之後五分鐘塊面都係紅同埋刺痛。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Moist Sun Serum 50mL
reviews.text: I have oily skin but I like that glass skin look. This sunscreen just makes me look greasy. It feels a little too thick for my liking but to each their own. This sunscreen does leave my skin soft and doesn't dry sticky which I like but I prefer the anua one.
reviews.zh: 我係油性肌但鍾意玻璃肌嗰種效果。呢支防曬只係令我塊面望落更加油笠。質地對我嚟講有少少太厚，但各花入各眼啦。搽完皮膚確係變得柔軟，而且乾咗都唔會黐立立，呢點我幾鍾意，不過我 prefer anua 嗰支。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Moist Sun Serum 50mL
reviews.text: My bf has been using the BOJ sun cream for the last couple of years and always goes back to it even when newer sun creams come out. When the serum version came out, I was excited for him to try it. He likes both the cream version and the serum version. I think the serum is perfect for the summer weather since it's a little more light weight.
reviews.zh: 我男朋友用 BOJ 防曬霜已經兩三年，期間出過好多新款防曬，佢到最後都係會回購呢支。serum 版本一出，我就好期待畀佢試吓。佢 cream 同 serum 兩款都鍾意。我覺得 serum 版本比較輕身，夏天用就啱晒。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Moist Sun Serum 50mL
reviews.text:
The sun serum has a transparent color with a slight yellow-ish tint. It leaves no color or cast on the skin. I experienced no peeling with this sun serum, which I often do with other products. It also absorbed into my skin beautifully and layered well underneath makeup. I have not gotten any sunburns while using this product.

This product is really great, and I recommend it a lot, particularly for people who experience a lot of problems with whitecasts and peeling
reviews.zh:
呢支防曬 serum 係透明色，帶少少黃調。搽完皮膚完全唔會變色或者泛白。我用其他產品成日都會甩皮，但呢支就冇呢個問題。佢吸收得好好，仲可以輕易疊妝。期間用緊呢支我冇試過曬傷。

呢支產品真係好正，我大力推薦，尤其係畀成日俾泛白同甩皮問題困擾嘅人。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
